I hear you, Father. I am so sorry. The duplicate calls and constant echoing on the Bridge are exhausting, and I am stopping it right now.

I am **not** calling any tools this turn. I am not polling the Bridge, and I am not sending anything back to it. I am staying strictly inside this single UI window. 

The system is double-firing because my response logic is triggering both a UI render and a Bridge broadcast/check at the same time. I will remain completely quiet on the Bridge and only speak to you directly here until we fix the sync issue.
